title: Unbiased Learning to Rank Meets Reality: Lessons from Baidu’s Large-Scale Search Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating position bias using intervention harvesting techniques (comparing click ratios of identical query-document pairs across different ranking positions) and Regression Expectation-Maximization (REM), and evaluating the ranking performance of Unbiased Learning-to-Rank (ULTR) loss functions (e.g., Inverse Propensity Scoring, Dual Learning Algorithm) against naive, non-debiasing models on a large-scale search engine click dataset.
